changes: Translation with Gemini: paste a free Gemini key in Settings → Reader → Translation and chapters are translated like a scanlation team would, with names and tone kept consistent
Whole chapters at once: a spinning egg screen shows while the chapter translates, with Skip to start reading right away (quick translations switch to the Gemini ones when they're ready)
No signal or out of Gemini's free limit? It uses Gemini Nano on your phone instead, then the quick offline translator
Translated chapters are saved and open instantly, and the next chapter gets translated while you read
Pages are read straight from their images now, and the little reading guides beside Japanese text (furigana) are skipped
Translate is now a toggle: turn it on and every page translates as it comes on screen, then stays translated while you scroll, zoom and turn pages
Translations are pinned to the page, so they move and zoom with it instead of floating on top
Text is grouped into whole speech bubbles first, and boxes never overlap each other anymore
Text size is fitted to each bubble once, so long lines shrink to fit instead of spilling out
Much faster: only new parts of a page are read, pages you go back to show instantly, and the language models stay loaded
Bubbles cut off at the screen edge wait until they're fully in view instead of being half-read
New Translation settings (Settings → Reader): pick a separate font for translations (Comic Neue by default), bold or regular, and which language the raws are in
Egg Drop has been removed; Share on a series works the way it did before
Egg Drop: tap Share on a series to send it to a friend with your stars and a short note. If they use Eggiku, the link opens that exact series
More → Egg Drops: every series friends have sent you, with new ones marked. Opening a drop from a source you don't have searches your sources for it
New achievements: an Egg Drops ladder for sending drops, and Got mail for opening your first one
Fixes from Komikku: global search no longer gets stuck loading, and extensions no longer show updates that came from a different repo
Stats are safer: restoring a backup can't be undone by the old stats in memory, and a damaged stats log is kept instead of being wiped
Panel peek can no longer crash the reader
Search: one card per series with Merged on, showing every source it's on. Compare sources counts chapters and crowns the best one
Search: Other names also searches the English, romaji and Japanese titles from AniList
Search: groups like "English" or "Raws" (plus a built-in Fast ones group), and Tag mode to search a genre across every source that has it
Search: filters for language, status, not in my library and minimum chapters, plus matches from your library, history and Egg Drops at the top
Search: each source gets a time limit, the fastest answers show first, and sources that keep failing sit out for a day (Settings → Browse)
Find by picture: the picture button in search, or share a screenshot to Eggiku, finds which series it's from
Repo health (Settings → Browse, or the heart button on the repos screen) shows repos that are down, slow or abandoned
Extensions update themselves in the background on Wi-Fi (Settings → Browse)
Reader: Panel by panel button for paged reading zooms panel to panel, and Translate page puts a translation over raw pages, all on your phone
Fold sync: keep library and progress the same on every phone through one file in Google Drive (Settings → Data and storage → Sync)
Egg hunt: six golden eggs are hidden around Eggiku. Hints are in Achievements
Reader: a headphones button in the bottom bar opens the audio output picker, so you can switch to your AirPods or other Bluetooth headphones without leaving Eggiku
Settings → Music → Audio output: open the picker, hide the reader button, or jump to Bluetooth settings to pair something new
Patch notes: after an update you see everything new since the last version you opened, even if you skipped a few
Settings → About → What's new now shows every Eggiku update

Smart tab in the Library: ready-made smart categories (Ready to binge, Nearly caught up, Dropped?, Stalled, Finished but never read, Top shelf, Fresh, Ready for offline) plus your own, built from rules. Nothing ever moves out of your categories
Your own coloured tags on series, shown on covers. Search #tagname in the Library to find them
Star rating and tags now sit right under the cover; a reading timeline on series pages
Reader: chapter-end card with time spent, streak and a bookmark button
Reader: hold a page to pop the panel up; let go to close it
Reader: about how many minutes are left in the chapter, a glow on the last page, page-turn vibration
Stats: genre breakdown, reading speed, and a monthly Wrapped notification
Compare achievements with a friend using a code
Glass look on pop-up sheets, three new hidden themes, app icon choices and app fonts
Browse: source speed test, recent and saved searches
Undo after marking read or deleting downloads on series pages and in Updates
Achievement ladders with lots of small tiers, counting all your reading history
18 badges plus 5 secret ones, and a shareable achievements card
Reworked sharpening that's much easier to see
Live sharpening and full-resolution long strip pages for sharper zoom (separate for folded and unfolded)
One-hand mode and a skipped chapter warning in the reader
Migrations: best source pick with side-by-side comparison, unsure matches held back, chapter numbering lined up, move a whole source at once, nudges when a series keeps failing
Star ratings, Top shelf, Dead series finder, achievements, Wrapped card you can save, smart downloads
The egg intro now plays on every phone
Fixed Find duplicates closing the app
Fixed Settings closing the app with the phone unfolded
Egg intro animation when the app opens
Eggiku updates in More: see your build against the newest one and install it in one tap
Find duplicates: keeps the one you've read most and merges progress, with undo
Migration preview, report and Undo last migration
Send your latest backup straight to Google Drive
Home screen widget with your streak, weekly goal and continue-reading covers
Cooking shelf and "cook until X new chapters"
Continue reading: swipe to skip, plus nudges for series you binged then dropped
Quick sort your library into categories, share a series with a friend, two more hidden themes
